name: @watergis/storybook
description: The Storybook of all packages: maplibre2svg and style-editor-ui composed into one site, shown on the demo site.

scripts.build-storybook: pnpm --filter @watergis/maplibre2svg build-storybook && pnpm --filter @watergis/style-editor-ui build-storybook && storybook build -o build && node scripts/compose.js
